messages:
sam_product: Heads-up: FINCorp reported Dedicated clusters intermittently returning 500s on model inference. Customer SLA says 99.9%, sales is asking for a hotpath. Need product decision: emergency hotfix vs schedule for next minor release. Any quick triage notes?

lina_support: Seeing uptick starting ~10:20 PST. Root cause looks like KMS timeout on key unwrap when request volume spikes. Error sample: `kms: unwrap error: deadline exceeded`

aj_sales: FINCorp is on reserved capacity + enterprise SLA. They pinged the AE — they expect something in 48h. If we can't promise that, need to set realistic comms.

maria_eng: Quick context: we rolled a KMS client change last week that added retry backoff. Might be related; on low memory boxes retry jitter + backlog seems to create cascading deadlines.

olivia_eng: Confirmed. Reproduced locally with synthetic load on Dedicated stack. If we revert client change to previous unwrap path, failures disappear. Patch size small (~20 LOC) but touches KMS client initialization used across inference runtime.

sre_oncall: Metrics to watch for canary: `5xx_rate`, `kv_cache_hit`, `p50_latency`. Suggest canary at 5->20% traffic, 30m steady-state checks, abort on 5xx spike > 2x baseline or p50 increase > 50ms.

maria_eng: Proposed options: 1) Hotpatch revert to prior KMS client (fast, lower risk feature-wise, can ship within 24-36h with canary). 2) Mitigation: increase KMS timeout and add circuit breaker (safer, needs QA, ~1 week). 3) Delay to next minor release (2+ weeks) — not acceptable w/ enterprise SLA.

aj_sales: Option 1 preferred by customer; they want a fast fix and explicit rollback plan. They also asked for temporary compensation window if we miss SLA.

sam_product: Decision leaning: proceed with option 1 hotpatch + labeled rollback path + coordinated comms. Need signoff from Eng + SRE and comms for FINCorp + internal stakeholders.

olivia_eng: I'll own the hotpatch PR and the canary. Plan: branch revert, add smoke test that hits KMS unwrap, small e2e, targeted canary to FINCorp's Dedicated pool first if allowed, otherwise 10% global.

sre_oncall: Canaries ready: we have route overrides for dedicated pools. I'll provision a temporary alert runbook: if `5xx_rate` > baseline*2 OR `p50_latency` > baseline + 50ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> rollback and page oncall.

sam_product: Comms draft to AE/Customer: "We’ve identified a regression in our KMS client impacting Dedicated inference under burst load. We will deploy a focused hotfix and run a controlled canary. ETA to start canary: 36h; full mitigation expected if canary stable within 48h. We will keep you updated every 6h." Any edits?

aj_sales: Add: include fallback options for them (restart cluster) and offer 48h SLA credit if we miss timeline.

maria_eng: Engineering checklist for hotpatch: PR + CI, e2e smoke, staging canary, production canary (10% 30m), rollback steps documented, postmortem owners assigned. I can have PR ready in ~8 hours.

sam_product: OK. Action items: 1) Olivia: open PR and tag @maria_eng (owner) 2) SRE: prepare canary policy & runbook 3) Aj: confirm comms + AE message 4) Lina: keep support thread updated with any new customer errors. We'll reconvene in 4h for status.

deploy-bot: Note: scheduled canary window must be approved by product leads and SRE prior to rollout.

olivia_eng: PR opened: `revert/kms-unwrap-backoff` -> linking to thread. Will tag reviewers.

sam_product: Thanks — setting follow-up reminder in 4h. 

lina_support: Noted. I'll attach latest error samples to the ticket and notify FINCorp AE of the plan. :thumbsup:
